parameters.query:
WITH input_data AS (
    SELECT $1::JSONB AS data
),

existing_approval AS (
    SELECT
        a.id AS approval_id,
        a.campaign_version_id,
        a.decision AS current_decision,
        a.expires_at,
        a.decided_at,

        cv.campaign_id,
        cv.version_number,
        cv.validation_status,

        c.campaign_code,
        c.status AS current_campaign_status,

        cl.client_code,
        cl.name AS client_name,
        cl.company_name,
        cl.email AS client_email

    FROM approvals a

    JOIN campaign_versions cv
        ON cv.id = a.campaign_version_id

    JOIN campaigns c
        ON c.id = cv.campaign_id

    JOIN clients cl
        ON cl.id = c.client_id

    CROSS JOIN input_data i

    WHERE a.decision_token =
        i.data->>'token'

    LIMIT 1
),

updated_approval AS (
    UPDATE approvals a

    SET
        decision =
            i.data->>'decision',

        reviewer_name =
            i.data->>'reviewer_name',

        reviewer_email =
            i.data->>'reviewer_email',

        feedback =
            NULLIF(
                i.data->>'feedback',
                ''
            ),

        decided_at = NOW()

    FROM existing_approval e

    CROSS JOIN input_data i

    WHERE a.id = e.approval_id

      AND a.decision = 'pending'

      AND a.expires_at > NOW()

      AND e.validation_status = 'passed'

      AND e.current_campaign_status =
          'awaiting_approval'

      AND i.data->>'decision' IN (
          'approved',
          'revision_requested',
          'rejected'
      )

    RETURNING
        a.id AS approval_id,
        a.campaign_version_id,
        a.decision,
        a.reviewer_name,
        a.reviewer_email,
        a.feedback,
        a.requested_at,
        a.expires_at,
        a.decided_at
),

updated_campaign AS (
    UPDATE campaigns c

    SET status =
        CASE updated_approval.decision
            WHEN 'approved'
                THEN 'approved'

            WHEN 'revision_requested'
                THEN 'revision_requested'

            WHEN 'rejected'
                THEN 'rejected'
        END

    FROM updated_approval

    JOIN campaign_versions cv
        ON cv.id =
           updated_approval.campaign_version_id

    WHERE c.id = cv.campaign_id

    RETURNING
        c.id AS campaign_id,
        c.campaign_code,
        c.status AS campaign_status,
        c.updated_at
),

enqueue_job AS (
    INSERT INTO automation_jobs (
        job_type,
        campaign_id,
        campaign_version_id,
        approval_id,
        status,
        payload
    )

    SELECT
        CASE updated_approval.decision
            WHEN 'approved'
                THEN 'create_production_tasks'

            WHEN 'revision_requested'
                THEN 'generate_revision'
        END,

        updated_campaign.campaign_id,

        updated_approval.campaign_version_id,

        updated_approval.approval_id,

        'queued',

        jsonb_build_object(
            'campaign_code',
                updated_campaign.campaign_code,

            'decision',
                updated_approval.decision,

            'reviewer_name',
                updated_approval.reviewer_name,

            'reviewer_email',
                updated_approval.reviewer_email,

            'feedback',
                updated_approval.feedback,

            'requested_version_id',
                updated_approval.campaign_version_id
        )

    FROM updated_approval

    JOIN updated_campaign
        ON TRUE

    WHERE updated_approval.decision IN (
        'approved',
        'revision_requested'
    )

    ON CONFLICT (
        approval_id,
        job_type
    )
    WHERE approval_id IS NOT NULL

    DO NOTHING

    RETURNING
        id,
        job_type,
        campaign_id,
        campaign_version_id,
        approval_id,
        status,
        available_at,
        created_at
),

write_log AS (
    INSERT INTO automation_logs (
        workflow_name,
        campaign_id,
        level,
        event_type,
        message,
        details
    )

    SELECT
        '06 - Process Campaign Decision',

        updated_campaign.campaign_id,

        'info',

        CASE updated_approval.decision
            WHEN 'approved'
                THEN 'campaign_approved'

            WHEN 'revision_requested'
                THEN 'campaign_revision_requested'

            WHEN 'rejected'
                THEN 'campaign_rejected'
        END,

        CASE updated_approval.decision
            WHEN 'approved'
                THEN 'The campaign package was approved by a human reviewer.'

            WHEN 'revision_requested'
                THEN 'The reviewer requested a new campaign version.'

            WHEN 'rejected'
                THEN 'The reviewer rejected the campaign package.'
        END,

        jsonb_build_object(
            'campaign_code',
                updated_campaign.campaign_code,

            'campaign_version_id',
                updated_approval.campaign_version_id,

            'decision',
                updated_approval.decision,

            'reviewer_name',
                updated_approval.reviewer_name,

            'reviewer_email',
                updated_approval.reviewer_email,

            'feedback',
                updated_approval.feedback
        )

    FROM updated_approval

    JOIN updated_campaign
        ON TRUE

    RETURNING id
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN updated_approval.approval_id
             IS NOT NULL
            THEN TRUE

        ELSE FALSE
    END AS processed,

    CASE
        WHEN updated_approval.approval_id
             IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'processed'

        WHEN existing_approval.approval_id
             IS NULL
            THEN 'invalid_token'

        WHEN existing_approval.current_decision
             <> 'pending'
            THEN 'already_decided'

        WHEN existing_approval.expires_at
             <= NOW()
            THEN 'expired'

        ELSE 'conflict'
    END AS result_status,

    CASE
        WHEN updated_approval.approval_id
             IS NOT NULL
            THEN
                CASE updated_approval.decision
                    WHEN 'approved'
                        THEN 'The campaign was approved successfully.'

                    WHEN 'revision_requested'
                        THEN 'The revision request was saved successfully.'

                    WHEN 'rejected'
                        THEN 'The campaign was rejected successfully.'
                END

        WHEN existing_approval.approval_id
             IS NULL
            THEN 'The approval token is invalid.'

        WHEN existing_approval.current_decision
             <> 'pending'
            THEN 'A decision has already been submitted for this review.'

        WHEN existing_approval.expires_at
             <= NOW()
            THEN 'This approval link has expired.'

        ELSE
            'The decision could not be processed because the campaign state changed.'
    END AS result_message,

    COALESCE(
        updated_approval.approval_id,
        existing_approval.approval_id
    )::TEXT AS approval_id,

    COALESCE(
        updated_approval.campaign_version_id,
        existing_approval.campaign_version_id
    )::TEXT AS campaign_version_id,

    COALESCE(
        updated_campaign.campaign_id,
        existing_approval.campaign_id
    )::TEXT AS campaign_id,

    COALESCE(
        updated_campaign.campaign_code,
        existing_approval.campaign_code
    ) AS campaign_code,

    COALESCE(
        updated_approval.decision,
        existing_approval.current_decision
    ) AS decision,

    updated_approval.reviewer_name,
    updated_approval.reviewer_email,
    updated_approval.feedback,
    updated_approval.decided_at,

    updated_campaign.campaign_status,

    enqueue_job.id::TEXT
        AS automation_job_id,

    enqueue_job.job_type,
    enqueue_job.status
        AS job_status,

    enqueue_job.available_at

FROM input_data

LEFT JOIN existing_approval
    ON TRUE

LEFT JOIN updated_approval
    ON TRUE

LEFT JOIN updated_campaign
    ON TRUE

LEFT JOIN enqueue_job
    ON TRUE;
